Jin (batcher): quick heads-up — internal perf sweep shows our decode-rate classifier is sending ~12% of midrate requests to the heavyweight kernel. that explains the cost blip in today's run. proposing new bin edges + kernel hints to reduce kernel-switch churn. https://dash.redwood/perf/runs/2026-03-18
Sara (runtime): can you paste the sampled hist and the exact config change you're proposing?
Jin (batcher): sure, small snippet of the proposal below (will open PR):
```
# proposed decode bins (tokens/sec) and token budgets
decode_bins: [0, 25, 70, 220, 1200]
prefer_kernel_map: ["int8", "fp16", "fp16-kv", "fused"]
token_budget_targets: { low: 16, mid: 48, high: 128 }
kv_prefetch_tokens: 512
```
Leo (ml): flagged: when you bias midrate to fp16-kv we saw KV-hit drop ~7% on long-context workloads in the sample set. that could explain p99 tail worsening.
Mike (perf): from profiling: kernel select overhead avg ~0.7ms, but on kernel-switch paths second-token stalls jump to ~3ms due to glue code and cache warmup. switching more aggressively will reduce cost but may increase tail latency.
Jin (batcher): notes: the misclassification mainly happens around 40-80 tokens/sec where decode slopes overlap. shifting the bin edge to 70 and preferring fp16-kv for decode_rate>70 cuts unnecessary fused-kernel escalations.
Anya (oncall): operational constraints: if we change bins we must canary 5% traffic + have rollback automations. add alerts for batcher.kv_evictions and tail_latency.p99 > 200ms.
Jin (batcher): ack — will add metrics: `batcher.kernel_switches`, `batcher.kv_evictions`, `batcher.last_switch_reason`, and `batcher.token_budget_util`. will also add a lightweight kernel-hint map in model manifest.
Sara (runtime): concrete canary plan: 5% traffic for 30m windows, observe p95/p99, kv miss rate, kernel_switch count. if p99 increases >3% or kv_evictions increase >5% rollback. timeline: start canary in ~30m.
deploy-bot: deploy canary started by Jin — rollout id 20260318-101, target 5% (started 1768460001) :rocket:
Mike (perf): during canary watch `gpu_busy_ms` and `kernel_select_ms`. I'll instrument a flame for the switch path to confirm the 2nd-token stall cause.
Leo (ml): also suggest a minor KV budget experiment: bump `kv_prefetch_tokens` to 768 for midrate to avoid evictions, monitor memory pressure.
Jin (batcher): will run two variants: A) bin-edge shift + fp16-kv prefer, B) same + kv_prefetch_tokens=768. compare p95/p99/cost.
Anya (oncall): oncall will be on standby for the next hour. add alerts to pager for p99 > 250ms.
Sara (runtime): SGTM. if canary metrics look stable after 30m we'll expand to 20% then 50% with same checks.
Jin (batcher): landing PR now: https://git.redwood/repo/batcher/pulls/342 — includes the `kernel_hint` shortmap to bias selection (non-blocking):
```
"kernel_hint": {
  "len>768": "fused",
  "decode_rate>70": "fp16-kv"
}
```
Sara (runtime): nice, keep the hint map conservative. we don't want hard pins.
Mike (perf): FYI I added a small microbenchmark for the glue path — will post results in 15m.
Anya (oncall): confirmed deploy-bot shows canary active. ping me if rollback needed. :white_check_mark:
Jin (batcher): thanks all — will post canary dashboard links and a short summary after 30m window. :eyes:
